artifact_reasoning: The primary artifacts are structural and textural. The launch tower exhibits significant geometric instability (melting beams, inconsistent lattice), a common AI failure mode for complex man-made structures. There is minor boundary bleeding between the shuttle components (SRBs and External Tank), indicated by the topology auditor's mask confidence of ~0.80. The exhaust plume lacks realistic volumetric complexity, appearing somewhat painterly. These issues prevent the image from achieving high artifact scores, though they do not obscure the main subject.
